articleTitle: Microsoft Copilot Studio：定位、能力、落地路径与费用

sources.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio Licensing Guide (November 2026)
keyFacts: Three harnesses: GitHub Copilot harness, Customer conversation harness (Public Preview), Standard harness; plus Apps in Copilot Studio (Paid Public Preview, hosted in Copilot Managed Runtime) and Copilot Chat agents

Four purchasing options in USD (pre-tax list prices): Pay-As-You-Go ($0.01/Credit, MACC-eligible, not Azure Prepayment eligible), Capacity pack ($200/25,000 Credits/month billed annually), Copilot Credit Pre-Purchase Plan (P3, 9 tiers 300K–300M Credits, 5%–20% discount), Microsoft Agent Pre-Purchase Plan (P3, 3 tiers 20K/100K/500K ACU, 5%/10%/15% discount, 1 ACU = $1 = 100 Credits across Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry)

Entitlements table (p.7): Microsoft Copilot USL includes Standard harness runtime usage under fair usage limits in Microsoft channels (B2E authenticated user), while GitHub Copilot harness and Customer conversation harness require Copilot Credits for runtime and LLM-powered maker experiences; Work IQ APIs are not included in Microsoft Copilot USL

Dataverse default per-tenant capacity (Database 15 GB, File 20 GB, Log 2 GB), add-on subscriptions ($40/$30 Tier 2/$2/$10 per GB/month), and PAYG meters ($48/$2.40/$12 per GB/month beyond 1 GB DB + 1 GB File per environment)
Business Application Tools including Model Context Protocol (MCP) consume Copilot Credits through usage-based billing and require underlying Dynamics 365 or Power Platform licenses

Appendix D Change Log: Nov 2026 guide adds Customer conversation harness (Oct 2026), Business Application Tools including MCP (Oct 2026), Copilot Managed Runtime & Build apps in Copilot Studio Paid Public Preview (Sep 2026)

sources.title: Microsoft Copilot Credits Guide (November 2026)
keyFacts: Copilot Credits span Copilot Cowork, Copilot in SharePoint and OneDrive, Copilot Code, Work IQ APIs, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence (CCI), Teams Phone Agent, Microsoft Copilot Managed Runtime, and Business Applications

Centralized FinOps management in Microsoft 365 admin center (MAC) alongside Power Platform admin center (PPAC); two estimators: Copilot Credit Estimator (for Copilot Cowork and GitHub Copilot harness) and Copilot Credit Estimator for agents

GitHub Copilot harness planning estimates (pp.16–17): Natural language creation Light (1–2 turns) 1–20 Credits, Medium (3–5 turns) 21–60 Credits, Heavy (6+ turns) 61+ Credits; Runtime Light 100–300 Credits, Medium 300–500 Credits, Heavy >500 Credits

Customer conversation harness (Public Preview) planning estimates (p.17): Light (~2 min voice / brief chat) Digital 5–15, GenAI Voice 20–30, Premium (S2S) Voice 34–44 Credits; Medium (~5 min) Digital 15–25, GenAI Voice 50–75, Premium (S2S) Voice 85–110 Credits; Heavy (~10 min) Digital 25–50, GenAI Voice 100–150, Premium (S2S) Voice 170–220 Credits

Copilot Managed Runtime (Public Preview, p.24–25): 0.1 Copilot Credits per API call (Light ~10–50, Medium ~300–500, Heavy ~3,000–5,000 Credits/app/month); included for Power Apps Premium USL users within request limits

Work IQ APIs & Business Application tools (pp.13–14, 25–26): Work IQ Chat/Context API is variable (illustrative Light 15–30, Medium 30–60, Heavy 60–100 Credits/task); Work IQ Tools API is static 0.1 Copilot Credits per API call

sources.title: Billing rates and management
keyFacts: Standard harness billing rates: Classic answer 1, Generative answer 2, Agent action 5, Tenant graph grounding 10, Agent flow actions 13 per 100 actions, AI tools basic 1 per 10 responses (0.1/1K tokens), standard 15 per 10 responses (1.5/1K tokens), premium 10 Credits per 1,000 tokens, Content processing 8 per page
Voice tiers (Standard harness): Classic Voice 10 Credits/min, GenAI Voice 35 Credits/min, Premium GenAI Voice 75 Credits/min (core agent activities included)

Reasoning model billing: Total cost = feature rate + Text and generative AI tools (premium) at 10 Credits per 1,000 billed tokens; prompt cache reads are not billed, while input tokens, output/reasoning tokens, and prompt cache writes are billed

Four official billing examples: Customer support agent (7,200 Credits/day), Sales performance agent (4,800 Credits/day), Order processing agent (20 Credits/order), and Customer support agent using reasoning model Claude Opus 4.7 (14,100 billed tokens = 141 Credits for ongoing conversation turn; 46,100 billed tokens = 461 Credits when starting a new conversation) plus feature rates

Overage enforcement (125%): when triggered, blocked agents stop responding, including in a conversation that is already in progress; agent flow enforcement blocks new agent flow runs when capacity hits 0 while allowing in-progress runs to complete and non-flow agent interactions to continue; per-agent monthly limits do not stop agent flows called by the agent

sources.title: Harnesses in Copilot Studio
keyFacts: Three harnesses in Copilot Studio: GitHub Copilot harness, Customer Conversation harness, and Standard harness
GitHub Copilot harness is a Copilot Studio authoring and orchestration framework (not the GitHub Copilot service); customer data is not sent to or processed by the GitHub Copilot service
Official comparison across Best for, How it works, Recovers from problems, Works with files, Skills and memory, Publishing, and Billing

sources.title: Standard harness licensing
keyFacts: Covers licensing for agents powered by the standard harness; distinguishes Azure Bot Service skills (standard harness) from agentic skills (GitHub Copilot harness)

States that a Microsoft 365 Copilot license lets you use Copilot Studio to build agents for the GitHub Copilot harness (subject to Copilot Credits for LLM-powered maker experiences and runtime per the Licensing Guide)
Lists zero-rated usage in Microsoft Copilot, Teams, or SharePoint for classic answers, generative answers, and tenant graph grounding by Microsoft 365 Copilot licensed users

sources.title: Overview of usage-based billing
keyFacts: Applies to agents, workflows, and apps powered by the GitHub Copilot harness and customer conversations handled by the Self-Service/Customer Assist Agent in Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence
Billing starts when you start building on the GitHub Copilot harness (natural language creation, previewing/testing, generating/creating agent evaluations consume credits)
Links to the usage-based Copilot Credits estimator (https://nptnlopppecostweb.azurewebsites.net/#/estimator) and enforcement policy for credits

sources.title: Overview - Microsoft Copilot Studio
keyFacts: Defines Agents, Workflows (GitHub Copilot harness drag-and-drop designer), Agent flows (established flow format on standard harness), and notes that the app creation experience in Copilot Studio is in preview
Introduces Build with natural language (preview) to generate a combination of agents and workflows in a single session
Lists the three harnesses: GitHub Copilot harness, Customer Conversation harness, and Standard harness

sources.title: Compare Copilot Studio agent harnesses & Agents powered by the GitHub Copilot Harness overview
keyFacts: Agents created with the GitHub Copilot harness cannot be transferred to the standard harness, and vice versa; migration is a re-architecture decision
GitHub Copilot harness includes a Bash container for secure data/file processing, persistent memory, skills, and Hooks (which replace system/intent topic triggers)

Feature comparison matrix between Standard and GitHub Copilot harnesses (e.g., Computer use is Supported on Standard and Planned on GitHub Copilot; Prompt tools replaced by Skills; SharePoint/WhatsApp/D365 Contact Center channels and Manual auth/Custom entities currently Supported on Standard and Not supported on GitHub Copilot harness)

sources.title: What's new in Copilot Studio & Automate web and desktop apps with computer use & Select a primary AI model
keyFacts: May–Sep 2026 releases: Computer use GA (5 Credits/step standard models: CUA, GPT-6 Sol, Claude Sonnet 4.5 GA, Claude Sonnet 4.6 Experimental; 15 Credits/step premium model: Claude Opus 4.6 Experimental), Agent evaluations GA, A2A protocol GA, Windows 365 for Agents MCP server GA, Workflows extract node GA & Copilot node (Preview), Work IQ / Fabric IQ / Foundry IQ (Preview)

Standard harness default model is GPT Chat Latest; legacy model retirements on Oct 15, Oct 31, and Nov 12, 2026 (GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 Mini, GPT-5 Chat/Auto/Reasoning retire Nov 12, 2026 except in FedRAMP and cross-geo restricted environments)
External models (Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.6 / 4.7 / 4.8 GA, Mistral, xAI Grok) require dual admin enablement in PPAC and M365 Admin Center and may involve cross-geo processing

sources.title: Security and governance & Manage Entra Agent IDs
keyFacts: Microsoft Agent 365 serves as a central control plane for Copilot Studio agents (Entra identity representation, Conditional Access, Microsoft Entra network egress/ingress controls GA)

Starting May–July 2026, Copilot Studio automatically creates a Microsoft Entra Agent ID for every new agent (replacing per-agent Azure app registrations) under global blueprint 25664c89-cea5-4ab6-b924-a54fd8a19ae0, attaches connector API permissions, and removes environment-level opt-out

Customer Lockbox exclusions: two outbound categories are excluded from Lockbox coverage—Copilot Studio security audit logging (processed by Microsoft Purview pipeline) and Agent 365 governance/audit events

Content moderation note: Copilot Studio moderates predefined harmful-content categories, but does not provide a tenant-configurable policy to block arbitrary admin-defined subjects or ethical categories

sources.title: Get access to Copilot Studio & Quickstart: Create and deploy an agent with the standard harness
keyFacts: Quickstart explicitly requires turning off the 'New experience' toggle on the Home page to access the Standard harness home page; turning on 'New experience' accesses the GitHub Copilot harness and App (Preview) tile
Trial license (30 days + 30-day extension; agent works up to 90 days after expiry) allows creating and testing agents in test chat but cannot publish
Teams plan in select M365 subscriptions is limited to classic orchestration, Dataverse for Teams, and Teams channel (excludes GCC/GCC High/DoD, EDU A1, SUB SKUs)

sources.title: Copilot Studio Agent Usage Estimator & Copilot Credits Estimator
keyFacts: Two official non-binding estimators: Copilot Credit Estimator (nptnlopppecostweb.azurewebsites.net/#/estimator) for Copilot Cowork and GitHub Copilot harness, and Copilot Studio Agent Usage Estimator (microsoft.github.io/copilot-studio-estimator/) for Standard harness / Copilot Studio & D365 agents
